dedupe_keys.name: ai4boundaries ai ready field boundary dataset sentinel 2 and aerial orthophotos jrc

description: AI4Boundaries is a benchmark dataset of images and labels for training and comparing machine learning models that detect agricultural field boundaries. It has two parts: 10 m Sentinel-2 monthly composites for large-scale retrospective analysis and 1 m aerial orthophotos for regional work such as extracting farmers' aid application parcels, with 7,831 samples of 256 by 256 pixels and 512 by 512 pixels respectively, each with vector ground-truth parcels (2.5 million parcels over 47,105 square kilometres) and ready-to-use rasters. Labels come from openly released 2019 Geospatial Aid Application data for Austria, Catalonia, France, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Slovenia and Sweden, 14.8 million parcels over 376,000 square kilometres, sampled by landscape fragmentation. It was produced by Raphaël d'Andrimont, Martin Claverie, Pieter Kempeneers and colleagues at the European Commission Joint Research Centre and partners, and described in Earth System Science Data on 18 January 2023. The data are available free on the JRC Open Data Catalogue; the article is CC BY 4.0. Caveats: labels cover one year and seven regions, and parcel rules differ by country. For simulation it trains models that map field parcels, the basic units for exposure analyses of crops to floods, droughts and other hazards. It is related to the harmonised IACS inventory record in this catalogue, which holds the underlying declared parcels.
